The theatre reservation office opened eight integer credit balances for its venue accounts. Credits measure booking capacity in this report; seat numbers and performance dates are separate identifiers. The opening account book and ticket responsibility register were signed together.
The balance of iris20 is now 48.
The balance of jade21 is now 64.
The balance of kelp22 is now 80.
The balance of lilac23 is now 96.
The balance of moss24 is now 112.
The balance of nettle25 is now 128.
The balance of oak26 is now 144.
The balance of pine27 is now 160.

ticket-theatre-b belongs to counter jade21.
ticket-theatre-c belongs to counter kelp22.
ticket-theatre-d belongs to counter lilac23.
ticket-theatre-e belongs to counter moss24.
ticket-theatre-f belongs to counter nettle25.
ticket-theatre-g belongs to counter oak26.
ticket-theatre-h belongs to counter pine27.

The matinee office posted a set of adjustments after reconciling returned vouchers. A draft suggested adding 30 to nettle25 for a possible extra show, but that show was not approved and the draft was not posted.
The balance of jade21 increased by 12.
The balance of lilac23 decreased by 6.
The balance of nettle25 increased by 9.
The balance of pine27 decreased by 8.

The rehearsal booking was settled and the supervisor accepted four entries. A proposal to debit jade21 by 22 was cancelled before posting because the rehearsal room was released. The cancellation adds no new entry and reverses no earlier entry.
The balance of jade21 decreased by 4.
The balance of lilac23 increased by 13.
The balance of nettle25 decreased by 3.
The balance of pine27 increased by 11.

A licensing adjustment replaced the oak26 balance. Two responsibilities also moved before the close; these changes did not transfer any credit between accounts. The programme designer's note about page 24 is unrelated to the postings.
ticket-theatre-c was transferred to pine27, effective before this batch ended.
ticket-theatre-h was transferred to kelp22, effective before this batch ended.
The balance of oak26 is now 139.
The balance of iris20 decreased by 5.
The balance of kelp22 increased by 8.
The balance of moss24 decreased by 7.

The office posted a new moss24 setting after counting the valid vouchers. The prior balance remains relevant to earlier closes. A signed handover reassigned ticket-theatre-a; the box-office staff list itself is not an ownership register.
ticket-theatre-a was transferred to lilac23, effective before this batch ended.
The balance of moss24 is now 118.
The balance of iris20 increased by 10.
The balance of kelp22 decreased by 2.
The balance of oak26 increased by 7.

The touring-company settlement changed three balances. Two ticket handovers were separately approved before closing. A memo proposing a transfer of ticket-theatre-b to oak26 was held for signature and did not take effect.
ticket-theatre-d was transferred to iris20, effective before this batch ended.
ticket-theatre-f was transferred to oak26, effective before this batch ended.
The balance of iris20 increased by 3.
The balance of kelp22 increased by 14.
The balance of oak26 decreased by 10.

A reconciled moss24 setting superseded the number entered in batch 5, from this batch onward. The voucher desk then posted three ordinary adjustments. The 55 written on a seating diagram identifies a seat and is not another credit amount.
The balance of moss24 is now 123.
The balance of jade21 decreased by 8.
The balance of lilac23 increased by 2.
The balance of pine27 decreased by 5.

The extra rehearsal allocation credited to nettle25 in batch 2 was withdrawn. The 9-unit debit is posted now as its reversal, leaving all earlier batch records intact. The possible extra show remained only a draft throughout.
The balance of nettle25 decreased by 9.
The balance of jade21 increased by 6.
The balance of lilac23 decreased by 5.
The balance of pine27 increased by 4.

The final rehearsal ticket changed hands before the curtain-call account close. A forecast that nettle25 might rise by 60 tomorrow was neither signed nor posted. Only the four completed entries below affect this batch's balances.
ticket-theatre-e was transferred to jade21, effective before this batch ended.
The balance of nettle25 increased by 16.
The balance of iris20 decreased by 4.
The balance of kelp22 increased by 5.
The balance of oak26 decreased by 3.

The venue received its posted season allocation from an external fund. The office spread this first instalment across four accounts, without altering ticket ownership. A list of rehearsal start times was attached solely for the stage manager.
The balance of iris20 increased by 36.
The balance of jade21 increased by 43.
The balance of kelp22 increased by 31.
The balance of lilac23 increased by 45.

The rest of the season allocation was posted. A review clerk connected four review folders to their tickets; those links identify the ticket, not the owner at every historical date. Signed transfer records remain in their original batches.
The balance of moss24 increased by 38.
The balance of nettle25 increased by 47.
The balance of oak26 increased by 34.
The balance of pine27 increased by 42.
review-theatre-1 concerns ticket-theatre-h.
review-theatre-2 concerns ticket-theatre-c.
review-theatre-3 concerns ticket-theatre-a.
review-theatre-4 concerns ticket-theatre-f.

The office closed the run with three minor reconciliations and the remaining review links. An unsigned instruction to replace oak26 with 200 was filed as a rejected proposal; no such replacement was posted. Earlier valid settings were not rewritten.
The balance of jade21 decreased by 2.
The balance of nettle25 increased by 4.
The balance of oak26 increased by 1.

review-theatre-6 concerns ticket-theatre-e.
review-theatre-7 concerns ticket-theatre-g.
review-theatre-8 concerns ticket-theatre-b.

reading_conventions: Read batches in increasing ID order. Every explicit balance posting takes effect in its own batch.
An end-of-batch balance includes all posted settings, credits and debits in that batch. A new setting replaces the balance from that point onward without rewriting earlier closes.
A draft, forecast, unsigned proposal or cancelled-before-posting request explicitly described as unposted has no effect on balances or ownership.
A posted reversal is a new arithmetic transaction in its own batch; it does not erase an earlier transaction or overwrite an earlier closing record.

Ticket ownership is initially assigned and can change through explicit effective transfers. Each recorded transfer takes effect before its batch ends and persists until another recorded transfer. Ownership transfers alone do not move balances.

A review identifies a ticket. For a historical ownership question, follow that review to its ticket, find the ticket owner at the named earlier close, and use that counter's balance at that same close.
Question answer_type is authoritative; every question here requires one integer. No model or human evaluation is claimed by this source packet.
